description: React component files implementing parts of a To-Do List application's UI, specifically a FilterBar for filtering tasks and a TaskList for displaying tasks with animations.

methods.name: FilterBar
methods.description: Renders filter UI tabs allowing users to select task filters ('all', 'active', 'completed') and updates the store filter state.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count of tasks corresponding to a particular filter.

methods.name: TaskList
methods.description: Displays a list of TaskCards based on current filtered tasks, with transition animations for entries/exits.
